data.name: Azha
data.gender_notes: Azha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: This name signifies the gift of life and existence. It is derived from the Arabic word 'aza' which means 'to live'. The name Azha carries the meaning “Life, existence” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashtun. Parents who choose Azha usually hope their child will grow to embody life, existence and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Azha is a name that is deeply rooted in spirituality and symbolizes the essence of life and existence. It is a name that is believed to bring blessings and prosperity to those who bear it.
data.etymology: Azha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Life, existence.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azha total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: أزها
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يدل على الاشراق والظهور والجمال
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أزها مشتق من أزهر، وهو ما يظهر ويشع نوراً، ويعبر عن الجمال والاشراق. وردت مشتقاته في القرآن الكريم، مثل {والنور الذي أنزلنا}، ويحمل دلالة على النور والهداية.

in_urdu.name: ازہا
in_urdu.meaning: نام جو اشراق ظہور اور خوبصورتی کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام ازہا عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے اشراق اور ظہور۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان مقبول ہے اور اس کا تعلق دینی و ثقافتی سیاق و سباق سے ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अज़हा
in_hindi.meaning: नाम जो प्रकाश और सौंदर्य को दर्शाता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम अज़हा अरबी मूल से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है प्रकाश और सौंदर्य। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में प्रयोग होता है और इसकी धार्मिक और सांस्कृतिक महत्ता है।

in_pashto.name: ازها
in_pashto.meaning: د نوم چې د رڼا او ښکلا معنی ورکوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: د ازها نوم په عربي ژبه کې د رڼا او ښکلا څخه مشتق شوی دی. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولنو کې کارول کیږي او د هغوی لپاره ځانګړی ثقافتی او مذهبي ارزښت لري.

in_english.name: Azha
in_english.meaning: Name signifying illumination, beauty, and radiance
in_english.long_meaning: The name Azha originates from Arabic roots, specifically from 'azhara,' meaning to illuminate or radiate. It symbolizes beauty, light, and guidance. Although not directly mentioned in the Quran, similar roots are found in {walnuri alathi anzalna}. The name carries spiritual significance, implying enlightenment and inner beauty, cherished across diverse Muslim cultures.
